title: The lane classifier is extension point lane: extensions.lane wins over lane_module, which stays a supported key for the kb's own kblane
goal: bl_land and bl_precheck take the lane classifier through kbext.load(lane): extensions.lane from the settings layers wins, else backlog.json's lane_module names the module and its path_lane function, else no code lane as now; lane_module stays a supported key of API 1, so backlog.json, the skills and the worker role keep their wording. kbext.py resolve lane prints which one decided, and a group lane extender's answer is the lane land and precheck read.

run:
import json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); subprocess.run(["git","init","-q",str(d)],check=True); e=d/"ext"; e.mkdir()
(d/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","lane_module":"kblane"}),encoding="utf-8")
k=lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbext.py",*a,"--root",str(d)],capture_output=True,text=True)
r=k("resolve","lane"); assert r.returncode==0 and "kblane" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)
(e/"grp_lane.py").write_text("KBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=1.0,<2\"\ndef path_lane(path):\n    return \"code\"\n",encoding="utf-8")
(d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"extensions":{"lane":"grp_lane:path_lane"},"extension_paths":["ext"]}),encoding="utf-8")
r=k("resolve","lane"); assert r.returncode==0 and "grp_lane" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)
r=k("call","lane","--json",json.dumps(["kb/public/x.md"])); assert r.returncode==0 and json.loads(r.stdout)=="code", (r.stdout,r.stderr)
